prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. TWO rows. TOP SUOYA adult female woodland hunter with private debt, dark low braid, brown wool knee tunic and worn olive cloak, ordinary unstrung hunting bow at side with no arrow drawn, alert guarded stance. BOTTOM FOLAN adult male pursuing his one private old loan, mature short grey beard, faded aubergine knee tunic and brown simple tie-neck coat, small CLOSED leather wallet at belt, empty hands. No threatening action, debtor family, address disclosure, arrest, debt clearance or sinister villain fantasy.
